title: TERLIMO mobile v1 one-time onboarding hour and data-access classes

OnboardingState.description: State of the one-time onboarding full-VPN hour.

OnboardingStart.description: The hour starts at the server-confirmed first connection after installation, NOT at APK download.

DataAccessClass.description: Precise data-access classes. `none` = control-only authorization (no VPN data). `onboarding_hour` = the one-time onboarding full-VPN hour. `restricted_checkout` = backend-issued bounded checkout/payment page and external bank redirect path, available without an active subscription. `subscription_data` = full VPN under an active trial/paid subscription.

started_at.description: Server-confirmed first-connection time (RFC3339 UTC) or null in not_started.

not_after.description: Server-fixed deadline = started_at + 3600s (RFC3339 UTC); null in not_started. refresh/restart/repeat NEVER extend it. Not a trial and not a paid entitlement.

unit.description: Server one-time unit = server-known installation/public-key fingerprint. The same known unit cannot restart or extend the hour.

post_telegram_identity.description: After Telegram binding, account history can additionally correlate units using the existing identity.

pre_telegram_reinstall.description: A pre-Telegram reinstall producing a genuinely new key may be indistinguishable from a first install; it is a separate server unit and may obtain another hour. Prevention is NOT guaranteed and is not claimed.

GrantResolution.description: Resolves the effective data-access class from onboarding state and subscription state. Management/announcement read alone grants no VPN.

restricted_checkout_available.description: backend-issued restricted checkout remains after the hour; external page/bank feasibility is TEST evidence pending.

effective_deadline.description: Deadline tied to the resolved class: onboarding_hour -> the hour not_after (always a finite string); subscription_data -> the subscription end (string), or null ONLY when the parent MeResponse carries entitlement.perpetual_commercial=true and entitlement.valid_until=null (the cross-object invariant is enforced on MeResponse); none/restricted_checkout -> null.
